questions.title: Father of the Java Language
questions.description: Java was created at Sun Microsystems in the early 1990s and grew into one of the most used languages in the world. Who is widely known as the father of the Java language?

questions.title: Original Name of Java
questions.description: Before it was renamed Java, the language developed by James Gosling's team at Sun Microsystems went by a different name inspired by an oak tree outside the office. What was that original name?

questions.title: Why Java Is Platform Independent
questions.description: One celebrated feature of Java is platform independence, summed up as Write Once, Run Anywhere. Which option correctly explains how Java achieves this?
questions.Option1: Java source code is compiled directly into machine code for each operating system
questions.Option2: The operating system recompiles the Java program every time it is run
questions.Option3: Java source is compiled to bytecode that any JVM can execute with the same behavior
questions.Option4: Java programs contain no compiled form at all and stay as editable text

questions.title: Command to Run a Compiled Class
questions.description: You compiled Hello.java with the javac compiler and now want to run the program from the command line. Which command is correct?

questions.title: What the JRE Contains
questions.description: The Java platform ships in several bundles. Which of the following best describes the Java Runtime Environment (JRE)?
questions.Option1: Only the javac compiler with no runtime at all
questions.Option2: The JVM together with the class libraries needed to run Java applications
questions.Option3: The JVM plus the compiler plus development tools like javadoc and jdb
questions.Option4: A graphical editor for writing Java programs

questions.title: JDK JRE and JVM Nesting
questions.description: The three core pieces of the Java platform nest inside each other like boxes. Which hierarchy is correct?
questions.Option1: The JRE contains the JDK, and the JDK contains the JVM
questions.Option2: The JVM contains the JRE, and the JRE contains the JDK
questions.Option3: The JDK contains the JRE, and the JRE contains the JVM
questions.Option4: The JDK and the JRE are independent of the JVM

questions.title: Predict the Concatenation Output
questions.description: This program is compiled and run. What exact line does it print on the console?

questions.title: Where Java Is Used Today
questions.description: Java quietly powers a huge share of the software around us. Which of the following is a genuine, widespread real world use of Java?
questions.Option1: Enterprise back end systems and Android app development
questions.Option2: Writing assembly routines that boot a CPU
questions.Option3: Designing the instruction set of a processor
questions.Option4: Replacing the kernel of a desktop operating system

questions.title: Two main Methods in One Class
questions.description: This class is compiled and then launched with the java command. What happens when it runs?
questions.Option3: It prints A followed by B
questions.Option4: It fails at runtime with an ambiguous main method error

questions.title: What a Class File Really Holds
questions.description: Hello.java compiles successfully into Hello.class. Which statement about the contents of Hello.class is true?
questions.Option1: It contains JVM bytecode that any JVM can load and execute
questions.Option2: It contains native machine code for the CPU it was compiled on
questions.Option3: It stores the original source code in encrypted form
questions.Option4: It must be recompiled for every operating system before it can run
